Jade_Mordekaiser.name: Mordekaiser
Jade_Mordekaiser.title: The Master of Metal
Jade_Mordekaiser.lore: - The abilities are completely different. Read the descriptions
Jade_Mordekaiser.blurb: - The abilities are completely different. Read the descriptions

spells.name: Mace of Spades
spells.description: Mordekaiser's next attack emits with such force that it echoes out, striking up to 3 additional nearby targets, dealing damage plus bonus damage. If the target is alone, the attack deals extra damage.
spells.tooltip:
Mordekaiser's next attack emits with such force that it echoes out, striking up to 3 additional nearby targets, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage.

If the target is alone, {{ alonedamage }} magic damage is dealt instead.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Creeping Death
spells.description: Unleashes a protective cloud of metal shards to surround an ally, increasing their armor and magic resistance and dealing damage per second to enemies in the cloud.
spells.tooltip: Unleashes a protective cloud of metal shards to surround an ally for {{ duration }} seconds, giving them <scaleArmor>{{ defensestats }} armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>{{ defensestats }} magic resistance</scaleMR> and dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> over the duration to nearby enemies.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Siphon of Destruction
spells.description: Mordekaiser deals damage to enemies in a cone in front of him.
spells.tooltip: Mordekaiser damages enemies in a cone in front of him, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Children of the Grave
spells.description: Mordekaiser curses an enemy, stealing a percent of their life initially and each second. If the target dies while the spell is active, their soul is enslaved and will follow Mordekaiser as a ghost for 30 seconds.
spells.tooltip:
Mordekaiser steals {{ totaldamage }}% maximum Health magic damage.

If the target dies while cursed, their soul is enslaved and will follow Mordekaiser as a ghost for {{ ghostduration }} seconds. Mordekaiser gains 20% of their Ability Power and Attack Damage, and the ghost's stats are enhanced.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Iron Man
passive.description: A percent of the damage dealt from abilities is converted into a temporary shield, absorbing incoming damage.
